text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Marcella Street, between Scarborough Golf Club Road and Samson Crescent. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Marcella Street.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Marcella Street, between Scarborough Golf Club Road and Samson Crescent. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of 11 speed humps on Marcella Street, between Scarborough Golf Club Road and Samson Crescent, generally as shown on Attachments 2 and 3, Drawings TC-525 and TC-526 dated May 2025, attached to the report (May 20, 2025) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
